verdict.rationale: AgentMail offers building blocks a developer could use to approximate focused streams: Labels to tag conversations, Lists to allow or block senders and domains, many inboxes per agent, relevance-ranked search, and webhooks to route events. Nothing in the evidence shows built-in stream splitting or priority-ordered triage, so a power user would have to build the categorization logic themselves. Missing for 10: automatic categorization into important/team/newsletter/calendar streams, priority-ordered triage views, calendar-invite detection, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
